platforms.name: Installable web app
platforms.shell: Web manifest and service worker around the shared web app
platforms.write: Add manifest.webmanifest with name, start_url, display and icons; add a real icon asset and service-worker.js with an offline cache; update index.html to link the manifest and register the service worker. Return the complete extra and changed files as JSON.

build.install: Serve the folder over HTTPS or localhost and install from the browser

platforms.name: Windows desktop
platforms.shell: Tauri v2 desktop shell with the shared web app in www/
platforms.write: Create a complete Tauri v2 project: package.json with @tauri-apps/cli (v2) in devDependencies; app-icon.svg (a square SVG app icon); src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/build.rs, src-tauri/src/main.rs and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json with a nonempty mainBinaryName for the executable, productName for the app, build.frontendDist set to "../www" and the icons that `tauri icon` writes to src-tauri/icons. The shared web app is already in www/. Include every file needed to build on Windows.

build.install: Install Node.js, Rust (rustup), Microsoft C++ Build Tools and WebView2
build.to_check: proven with the fixed sample app on a GitHub Windows machine; an app a model wrote can still need setup the sample did not

platforms.name: iOS
platforms.shell: Capacitor iOS app wrapping the shared web app in www/
platforms.write: Create package.json with @capacitor/core and @capacitor/ios in dependencies and @capacitor/cli in devDependencies, and capacitor.config.json with appId (reverse domain), appName and webDir "www". Do not write the ios/ folder: `npx cap add ios` generates the native project. The shared web app is already in www/. Do not add scripts to package.json.

build.to_check: unsigned simulator build proven with the fixed sample app on a GitHub macOS machine; a signed device build is not checked

platforms.name: Android
platforms.shell: Capacitor Android app wrapping the shared web app in www/
platforms.write: Create package.json with @capacitor/core and @capacitor/android in dependencies and @capacitor/cli in devDependencies, and capacitor.config.json with appId (reverse domain), appName and webDir "www". Do not write the android/ folder: `npx cap add android` generates the native project. The shared web app is already in www/. Do not add scripts to package.json.

build.install: Install Node.js, a JDK and Android SDK (set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME)
build.to_check: debug APK proven with the fixed sample app on a GitHub Linux machine; a signed release build is not checked
